## Filtrations

A *filtration* is a nested sequence of complexes
$$
\emptyset = K_0 \subseteq K_1 \subseteq \dots \subseteq K_n = K.
$$

For a point cloud $X$, the Vietoris–Rips complex $\mathrm{VR}_r(X)$ contains a simplex for every finite set of points with pairwise distances at most $r$. Increasing $r$ gives a filtration.

## Persistent homology groups

Inclusions induce maps $H_k(K_i) \to H_k(K_j)$ for $i \le j$. The persistent homology groups are their images:
$$
H_k^{i,j} = \operatorname{im}\big( H_k(K_i) \to H_k(K_j) \big).
$$

Each homology class has a *birth* and a *death*. The multiset of pairs $(b, d)$ is the **persistence diagram**; drawn as intervals, it is the **barcode**.
